messages:
mina: Heads-up — found a potentially dangerous Go quickstart snippet in the README-sample-app. Someone pasted a literal token into the sample app README and a user copied it to a public repo. Filing SUP-4620.

oscar: link? where is it?

mina: docs/quickstart/go.md, the example shows:

```mina: package main

import (
  \"fmt\"
  \"net/http\"
  \"bytes\"
)

func main() {
  req, _ := http.NewRequest(\"POST\", \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\", bytes.NewBuffer([]byte(`{"prompt":"hi"}`)))
  req.Header.Set(\"Authorization\", \"Bearer sk-EXAMPLETOKEN\") // <- literal token
  client := &http.Client{}
  resp, _ := client.Do(req)
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  fmt.Println(resp.Status)
}
```

paige: yikes. Also the example doesn't set timeouts and suggests a naive retry loop in the sample app repo README (copy/pasteable), which will exacerbate issues.

oscar: Agreed. Fix checklist: remove literal, switch to os.Getenv(\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\"), add http.Client with timeouts, show a safe one-shot pattern and then the SDK usage that explains auto-retries and pooling.

paige: Proposed minimal safe raw example:

```paige: apiKey := os.Getenv(\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\")
client := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
req, _ := http.NewRequest(\"POST\", \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\", bytes.NewBuffer([]byte(`{"prompt":"hi"}`)))
req.Header.Set(\"Authorization\", \"Bearer \"+apiKey)
resp, err := client.Do(req)
if err != nil { log.Fatalf(\"request failed: %v\", err) }
// handle resp
```

paige: And the SDK snippet:

```paige: import \"github.com/redwood-inference/go-client\"

c := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{APIKey: os.Getenv(\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\")})
// SDK auto-retries 429/5xx with jittered exponential backoff by default
res, err := c.Generate(\"hi\")
```

mina: Also include how to opt out of retries for callers who need granular control (retries:0 or retry policy example).

oscar: CI guard: add a docs lint rule to fail if regex `(sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,})` or `REPLACE_ME` appears in *.md or *.go examples. linter-bot can post a failing comment on PRs.

linter-bot: Suggestion: add pre-commit md-lint hook and a docs pipeline check. YAML snippet: `grep -E \"sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}|REPLACE_ME\" docs/ || exit 1`.

paige: I'll open a PR that replaces the literal, adds the safe raw-http snippet, the SDK snippet, an opt-out example, and the CI grep. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712 — title: \"quickstart/go: remove hardcoded token, add safe raw-http + SDK notes + docs-lint\"

docs-bot: New PR opened by paige: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712 — title: \"quickstart/go: remove hardcoded token, add safe raw-http + SDK notes + docs-lint\"

mina: After merge, notify security to rotate leaked token and ping support so they can close SUP-4620. Thanks! :pray:
